eyebrow: A pre-mortem, run on yourself first
code:
For each major component, ask out loud before the real review:

  COMPONENT        FAILS HOW           BLAST RADIUS       MITIGATION
  primary DB       region outage       checkout + orders   warm standby, 4-min RTO
  cache layer      node eviction       stale reads only     5-min TTL, no write path
  payment API      3rd-party down      checkout blocked     queued retry, degrade gracefully
caption: Ask the failure question yourself, with your own team, before the review does.
